short: Makes sure it doesn’t lose access after a reboot or a password change.
analogy: Makes a spare key so it can come back anytime.

solutionNotes.edr: Spots new services, tasks and autostart entries and removes them.
solutionNotes.siem: Alerts on new accounts and changes to permissions and sign-in settings.
solutionNotes.ueba: Notices when an account suddenly gets new permissions or access.
solutionNotes.dfir: Finds every “backdoor” left after an incident so the attacker can’t return.
solutionNotes.pam: Limits who can create accounts and hand out permissions.
solutionNotes.caasm: Shows accounts and devices nobody knew about.
solutionNotes.cnapp: Spots changes to roles, keys and images in the cloud.
